pre_freeze_disclosure.summary: No new diagnostic was run for this plan. The design uses only the sealed, already-scored study-015 / study-016 results (Observed on SEEN data): every DLF / RSX / RSXL false certificate in studies 015-016 (ood4 8140016 m0.35; ood4 8240010 m0.6) and all 48 study-016 stress false certificates were on target x library pairs whose license bound n_L + margin was below the target's true size; inside the guarantee 0 false (study-015 diagnosis: DLFp 0 / 1,542, RSXp 0 / 1,854). RSXL4 dC +0.049 [0.041, 0.057]; RSXLp TV +1.44 over RG4; ood5 RG4 155 false, RG5 0; one 285 s whole-box heartbeat gap. Design note (Exact lemma, from the DLF definition): a library license certifies only when the bounded region at n_L + margin forces the answer; when n_L + margin >= FB that region contains the RG_FB region, so its forcing implies RG_FB's. A license kept inside the attested bound therefore never certifies anything RG_FB does not (study-016 R_DLF2: DLF2 = RG4 on all 360 cases, Observed). Every DLF speed and coverage gain so far came from assuming a bound below FB, which the evidence cannot certify (EB unsound, studies 015-016). v0.15.0 therefore moves the headline from the license to the action chooser before the first certificate.
pre_freeze_disclosure.label: Observed on seen data; the predictions below are Inferred unless marked Exact

hypotheses.H_att_exact: Exact lemma (reported, not gated): the attested license DLFa (use the library only when n_L + margin >= FB) issues exactly RG_FB's certificates on every trajectory. Checked on every case in GS_b5.
hypotheses.H_rgl: Bounded-lookahead chooser RGL: before RG4's first certificate on the trajectory, choose the action a that maximises the support-weighted fraction of outcomes o (readings consistent with the RG4 region after a) after which the RG4 region forces the next reading for SP8's next action; ties go to the SP8 choice. After the first certificate, use the frozen RSX choice (as RSXL). Certified by RG4 (arm RGLX4). Soundness is Exact (RG4 is sound in-family on any trajectory); whether it reaches the first certificate sooner than SP8's trajectory is Open (RSX, which splits the region evenly instead, was 5.27 steps slower in study-015).
hypotheses.H_rsxl_rep: Replication: RSXL4 dC = C(RSXL4) - C(RG4) >= 0.03, CI lower > 0, on fresh seeds (study-016: +0.049 [0.041, 0.057]).
hypotheses.H_ood5: With FB = 5 attested on ood5 targets, RG5 and RSXL5 issue 0 false certificates (Exact in-family); speed and coverage reported.
